title: Carolina Triple Glass Shelf, 16-Inch Wall Mount With Solid Brass Hardware | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need more bathroom storage but don’t want to give up counter space? This Carolina triple glass shelf adds three tiers of wall-mounted organization in a refined, traditional style.

  • More storage in the same footprint — three-tier design makes smart use of vertical wall space for daily essentials.
  • A cleaner finished look — concealed screw mounting hardware keeps installation hardware out of sight.
  • Built with durable materials — thick, beveled-edge glass paired with solid brass hardware.
  • Easy to coordinate — designed to complement the Carolina collection for matching Carolina, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.

Specs & Installation

  • Product type: Triple glass shelf (wall mount)
  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Approx. overall (16-inch model): 16 in L x 5.54 in D x 16 in H
  • Weight (16-inch model): 11.2 lbs
  • Mounting: Wall-mounted with concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Materials: Thick, beveled-edge glass; solid brass hardware
  • Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
